items.title: Coca-Cola Looks To Sell Costa Coffee, Semafor Reports
items.summary: Coca-Cola is seeking to unwind its $5 billion (€4.5 billion) acquisition of British coffeehouse Costa Coffee, Semafor reported.

items.title: Unide Continues To Expand With 36 New-Store Openings In 2026

items.title: Mars sees shopping lists disappear: AI takes over routine purchases
items.summary: Consumers will increasingly rely on digital assistants for their daily shopping, while brick-and-mortar stores will need to focus more on the shopping experience and discovery. That is Mars’ prediction, based on research into more than 180,000 data sources.
